notes: Nineteenth run, Tuesday, weekly sources off. Lookback 7 days (2026-09-29 to 2026-10-06). Yesterday's 18 unscored ids were already oldest-first; the oldest 15 were scored. Thirteen HOLD and two REJECT. The HOLDs are eight under E-QEC only (including a Hastings-Haah Floquet-code circuit scored as an error-correcting circuit, not as a clock), one DIII-D world model under E-RL with no coil command, one Vlasov-Maxwell PT-symmetry note under S-L3 with no Q_eng, one Majorana-shutter scattering note under E-MZM (WATCH, so A1 fails; not an X and Z logical), one sixteenfold-way decoherence note under E-S3 only (Walker-Wang bulk, not an AdS encoder, so not E-HOL), and one E-S3+E-QEC bridge on exact recovery for non-Abelian D(G) surface codes. Coupling stays C1. Two REJECT on the E-HOL denylist. No ADD, no STRENGTHEN, no new pillar, no CUT reversal. C unchanged. DBE-0.2.2 / DBES-0.2.0 stand. Q=1000 remains a ledger stress test. The Monday evening listing is in and left mostly unscored: quant-ph 129, str-el 16, mes-hall 20, hep-th 19, plasm-ph 6, all dated 2026-10-05. ingest.py was not executed: it fires seven arXiv requests with no sleep and would break the 1 request / 3 s rule. Its QUERIES were run with a 3.2 s gap and a submittedDate filter. fetch_arxiv.py was not run in write mode. OpenAlex, Crossref, and Unpaywall skipped (OPENALEX_API_KEY and DBE_CONTACT_EMAIL unset). No PDF cached (DBE_FULLTEXT_STORE unset; research/fulltext.json still does not exist and was not created). Popularity is 40 because Semantic Scholar was skipped; it is not a citation count. Harvest confidence is round(raw x 0.88) for preprint tier 0.7. Dedupe treated the 15 papers on unmerged PR #4 as already taken, so this branch does not open a second row for them. Prompt freeze text matches the files: DBE-0.2.2 / DBES-0.2.0, claims freeze 2026-10-02. No suspicious instructions in fetched abstracts.
